title: From raw imagery to hard data: The crucial role of AI in construction documentation
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) transforms construction documentation by automatically mapping 360° imagery to architectural drawings and BIM models. This improves jobsite-to-office communication, reduces rework costs and ensures GDPR compliance through automated face blurring.
